title: Interleaved model cost
statement: Let $x$ assign a sign to each of nine coordinates, and let a seed consist of four indices in $\{0,1,2\}$. Use its first index to select three top-level blocks, and use the remaining three indices with each selected block to determine its leaf seed. The interleaved model cost is the ordered interleaved model cost for those three blocks and leaf seeds.
hypotheses_covered: A seed consisting of four indices in {0,1,2}
A sign assignment on nine coordinates
caveat: The supplied context does not define the top-level block or leaf-seed selection maps.
